title: Wounded foes flee once
prompt:
You are working in a folder that contains one file, game.html: the single-file Three.js game "Остров сумерек". Edit game.html in place.

Task T3. Make wounded enemies run away once.
Requirements:
1. When a non-boss enemy that is alive has hp <= 25% of its maximum hp, it switches to the existing 'flee' state with a timer of at least 3 seconds and runs away from the player.
2. This happens only once per enemy: after the flee ends it must not start fleeing again, even though its hp is still low.
3. Enemies above 25% hp behave exactly as before. The boss (warden) never flees this way.
4. The page must still load and run without JavaScript errors.
The game exposes a debug handle window.__isle (see the end of the script) that you may use to try your change in a browser. Do not rename or remove existing code. When you are done, stop; do not write explanations into the file.
scope: small gameplay change in game.html, deterministic headless acceptance test (Playwright + window.__isle)
